name: 三界神话V1.50
english_name: Myth of the Three Realms (Wisteria Branch)
english_description: The second build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, the Baoji-station original) — content for the Wisteria branch server, which differs somewhat from the Baoji station but shares the same core codebase. Kaifeng city is a substantial standalone puzzle-quest zone later reused by the "Chutian" server, and the game's own included notes candidly admit it "still has bugs galore, including one known (minor) backdoor."
